Sanjay: Heads-up — planning a compact-quant profile swap on runtime nodes in us-west-2 tonight, 02:00-02:30 UTC. Need owner, smoke plan, rollback readiness. :wave:
Devon: I can own the window. I'll be on call. What's the exact profile id?
Sanjay: profile id `compact-qv2` — PR #3482 is the followup. Swap is non-disruptive but we want quick perf/latency checks.
Devon: Cool. I'll run smoke steps: 1) run `wrk -t2 -c50 -d30s https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` 2) check p50/p95 in Console 3) tail runtime pod logs for OOM or kv cache errors.
Kai: FYI make sure KV cache retention flag `--kv-prefix-cache=on` is left unchanged. Also set `BATCH_MAX=8` env for this window to be conservative.
Ashley: Pinged CR reviewer @maria for LGTM on PR 3482. Also can we do a quick canary slice? 5% traffic to compact-qv2.
Devon: Will do 5% canary with `route: weight 95/5` and monitor traces. If error rate >0.5% for 10m, rollback.
OpsBot: SCHEDULED WINDOW: compact-qv2 swap — 2026-03-18 02:00-02:30 UTC — owner: Devon — watchers: Kai,Ashley — automated rollback hook enabled.
Sanjay: Rollback steps: revert traffic weights, `kubectl apply -f route-stable.yaml`, then `kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime` if latency doesn't recover. Also capture a diagnostic dump: `./scripts/collect-runtime-dump --since 15m`. Confirm?
Devon: Confirmed. I'll post a pre-flip checklist 15m before flip and a post-flip quick report. :thumbsup:
Ashley: I'll watch infra metrics and traces, ready to flip back. If anomalies, I'll call timeout and trigger rollback.
Sanjay: Thanks — I'll update the runbook with the exact commands and PR link. Drop updates here when ready.
